component.name: SC3U Linux Installer
component.summary: Install the native Linux edition of SimCity 3000 Unlimited from your own disc

description.p: An unofficial community installer for the Loki Linux edition of SimCity 3000 Unlimited on modern distributions. It adds the 2.0a update, a compatibility runtime, a launcher and working sound through osspd and PipeWire.
No game data is included. You need your own Linux edition disc or ISO. You can also install the runtime first and add the game files later.
